title: City Brew Coffee — AM Review Board
subtitle: Keith asked: brainstorm some social media posts for summer drinks at City Brew Coffee.
guardrails: Use real client assets where possible. AI mockups are visual direction only. Do not invent product claims, offers, or drink names.

ideas.title: First Sip Soundcheck
ideas.dependency: Approved drink names/taste notes/assets if product-specific.
ideas.summary: A sensory cold-drink Reel built around actual audio/visual texture: ice scoop, lid snap, straw punch, swirl, first sip. Hook: 'You can hear when summer starts.' Uses approved summer drinks without needing a big shoot.
ideas.visual_direction: A sensory cold-drink Reel built around actual audio/visual texture: ice scoop, lid snap, straw punch, swirl, first sip. Hook: 'You can hear when summer starts.' Uses approved summer drinks without needing a big shoot.
ideas.caption: Draft caption after drink names and approved assets are confirmed.
assets_needed: Fallback: graphic treatment using approved product categories
ideas.room_notes: Moxie/Riff notes are compact source material, not client-facing copy. Moxie: Moxie kill gate: Overall: Strong batch, but the winners need named drinks and local/use-case specificity so they don’t become pretty-but-generic iced content. 1) First Sip Soundcheck — Keep — Best thumb-stop potential with a clear 1-second sensory hook and easy production from light in-store capture. 2) Order Like a Local: Summer Edition — Revise — Great brand fit, but needs approved Mountain West moments and exact drink names to avoid vague “summer lifestyle” copy. 3) One Drink, Three Summer Jobs — Keep — Useful if the client has one hero drink, and it gives routine/value customers clear reasons to order. 4) Barista Receipt Notes — Keep — Human, local, low-lift, and flexible across multiple drinks without requiring on-camera talent. 5) Summer Drink Proof Test — Revise — Visually strong, but currently overlaps…

ideas.title: Barista Receipt Notes
ideas.dependency: Approved drink names/taste notes/assets if product-specific.
ideas.summary: Barista writes tiny recommendation notes on receipt/cup sleeve: 'for sweet-tooth days,' 'for not-too-sweet people,' 'for iced-coffee loyalists.' Hook: 'If your order had a note from the barista…' Human, low-lift, product-accurate.

ideas.title: One Drink, Three Summer Jobs
ideas.dependency: Approved drink names/taste notes/assets if product-specific.
ideas.summary: Feature one priority summer drink across three real use cases: morning iced upgrade, afternoon reset, after-dinner treat. Hook: 'This one works harder than your average summer drink.' Good if client only has one hero product.
